name: agent-sdk
description: Create, review, debug and manage Claude Agent SDK (Python) agents, and create, run, review and analyze their evaluations. Deterministic stdlib validators plus interactive, options-first skills: an eval runner that lives in your project, plugin-eval-style cases and graders, LLM-as-judge through the SDK, pass@k, simulated users, mocked MCP tools, fault injection and CI gates. Subscription-first: runs and judges spend your Claude plan tokens unless an API key is set.
